# Handpan Chords

> Free chord flashcards and printable poker-size chord cards for handpans, with a page for each scale.

- [Handpan Chords app](https://handpantheory.com/): the flashcard app
- [Handpan 101](https://handpantheory.com/handpan-101/): a beginner guide
- [Scales](https://handpantheory.com/scales/): every scale
